# mcp-cfdi-mx

> MCP server for Mexican electronic invoicing (CFDI 4.0, Complemento de Pagos 2.0), PAC-agnostic sealing

## Docs

- [Overview](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-cfdi-mx/): the full README — what this server does, installation, configuration, available tools
- [Tools](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-cfdi-mx/tools/): full MCP tool reference
- [Changelog](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-cfdi-mx/changelog/): version history
- [Contributing](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-cfdi-mx/contributing/): dev setup and PR checklist
- [Security](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-cfdi-mx/security/): vulnerability disclosure policy
